message.content: **Analysis:** FY2024 (ended 9/28/24) showed revenue of $391.0B (+2% YoY), gross margin expanding to 46.2% from 44.1%, operating income of $123.2B, and operating cash flow of $118.3B. Net income ($93.7B) and diluted EPS ($6.08) declined slightly versus FY2023, but that is entirely explained by a one-time $10.2B net tax charge from the EU State Aid decision — operating income actually rose ~7.8%. Services revenue grew 13% to $96.2B at a 73.9% gross margin, providing durable, high-margin mix shift, and the company returned $95B of buybacks plus $15.2B of dividends while holding $140.8B in cash and marketable securities. Risks are real (Greater China net sales −8%, DOJ/EU antitrust, DMA) but don't outweigh the cash generation. The stock at $222.70 is a reasonable entry, so I'll buy within the mandate.
